serviceBaseUrl.description: Select the local service origin; not a deployed URL.

get.description: Shared health shape for all three services. Incoming request IDs are optional and ignored, including malformed/duplicate values. Authentication errors return 401 with a fresh diagnostic ID; successful and not-ready health results need no ID. No model/provider calls or request-body retention.

401.description: Missing or invalid service authentication. Generate a fresh diagnostic UUID, ignoring all incoming X-Request-ID values; return unauthorized with retryable=false. The response header and envelope IDs must match.

X-Request-ID.description: Server-generated diagnostic UUID; never echo an incoming health request ID.

200.description: Ready in the explicitly declared mode.

503.description: Not ready; this health endpoint returns HealthResult, not a business ErrorEnvelope.
